description: Flat chronological list of events grouped by date, showing time ranges, titles, descriptions, and color-coded dots. Each group reads as a row: the day number, weekday and month stacked on the left, then the events. A range with no events renders the shared TmEmptyState (TmScheduler_AgendaEmptyTitle, TmScheduler_AgendaEmptyDescription) inside tm-scheduler-agenda-empty. Displays AgendaDays (default 30) of events from the start date. Accessibility: a role=list (only when there are events) whose items each hold a role=group labelled by the date, and every event is a native button. An EventTemplate must not contain its own focusable element.

parameters.name: AgendaDays
parameters.description: Number of days to show in the agenda. Values below 1 are treated as 1.

parameters.name: SelectedEvent
parameters.description: The selected event. The matching row gets aria-current and tm-scheduler-agenda-event--selected.

parameters.name: SelectedEventChanged
parameters.description: Fires when the user selects an event.

parameters.name: OnEventClick
parameters.description: Fires when an event is clicked.

parameters.name: EventTemplate
parameters.description: Optional custom event renderer used inside each agenda row. The row chrome (the colour dot) stays; the time, title and description are replaced.
